name: Fuente Encalada (Spain)
description: White field with a red diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged with a red Greek cross at the upper hoist and a green bunch of grapes at the lower fly.
history: The full council of Fuente Encalada, in session on 22 June 2006, approved the heraldic arms and municipal flag; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of a white cloth with a red diagonal stripe from the lower hoist corner to the upper fly corner, of a third of the width, accompanied by a red Greek cross in the hoist triangle and a green bunch of grapes in the fly triangle.

features.role: band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, a third of the width
Greek cross at the upper hoist
